Chapter 1087: 20 - A Long Thousand Years (Request Subscription)_3

Chapter 1087: Chapter 20 – A Long Thousand Years (Request Subscription)_3

The middle-aged woman personally experienced the end of the Starry Sea Era. At that time, human civilization officially announced that the universe was about to be destroyed and would adopt a lottery method to select citizens to migrate to a new home.

And the probability of being selected? Out of about one or two hundred citizens, roughly one would be chosen.

Back then, the middle-aged woman was selected, but her father and mother, friends, and classmates were not selected.

In other words, waiting for the middle-aged woman was the outcome of living alone while her close relatives and friends all perished.

In such circumstances, the despair of the middle-aged woman was imaginable. Ultimately, she chose to give up her selected spot, staying behind to walk through the last phase of life with her loved ones and friends.

But at this time, the galaxy’s strongest announced that all citizens could be brought along to journey together to the new home.

This scene of seeing hope amidst despair is still clearly remembered by the middle-aged woman.

For human civilization, the galaxy’s strongest is no longer just about great achievements; that is a savior saint.

“Let’s talk about Martial Tao then.”

The middle-aged woman continued to ask.

“Martial Tao is the path taken by the galaxy’s strongest.”

Sun Ming felt a surge of joy in his heart, for he also knew the answer to this question.

“In the 40th year of the Galaxy Calendar, the galaxy’s strongest used Martial Tao as the foundation to develop six hundred and seventy-three great paths. These paths encompass most of the currently known roads, and all can enter the twelfth layer. In the 45th year of the Galaxy Calendar, many evolutionary paths that were prevalent in the old calendar gradually became obsolete…”

Sun Ming’s tone was exceptionally excited.

Though he has not yet practiced Martial Tao, he had long decided that the evolutionary path he would pursue in the future would be Martial Tao.

“Mm…”

The middle-aged woman’s listening seemed a bit lost; these newly born new humans couldn’t perceive the changes in human civilization after the Galaxy Calendar.

Especially the scene where many evolutionary paths gradually became replaced by Martial Tao… who knows how many powerful evolutionaries of the old calendar were moved by this.

…

Deep within the ‘Fragment World’ of Star Tear.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, clearly observing how the various branches of Martial Tao had spread thoroughly within human civilization, replacing the numerous evolutionary paths of the Starry Sea Era.

This was an inevitable result.

After all, the Martial Tao branches opened up by Lin Yuan, whether in terms of potential, difficulty in cultivation, or any other aspect, far surpassed the numerous evolutionary paths of the Starry Sea Era.

Even the nine strongest beings of human civilization took the initiative to switch to the branches of Martial Tao, let alone the ordinary human citizens.

Moreover, regardless of which branch of Martial Tao, due to their foundation being Martial Tao, cultivators of different branches can communicate and collide with each other.

“I can feel that even in distant other Void Domains, Martial Tao cultivators have been born.”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed and nodded slightly.

This situation likely arises from the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion beginning to propagate the Martial Tao branches.

The Eye of Myriad Laws reached an agreement with Lin Yuan, and afterward, showed no sign of slacking but immediately instructed each of the Myriad Laws branches to spread the path.

“The spread rate is very fast, currently the number practicing has already surpassed the total number of human civilization’s Martial Arts Evolutionaries.”

Lin Yuan contemplated that within the universe, the number of human civilization citizens is substantial, but compared to the Chaos Void, they are notably insignificant.

Now the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion is still in the initial propagation stage, and when it starts to spread deeply, the number of lives practicing Martial Tao will see a significant surge.

…

Source World.

Qingfen City.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, feeling the essence of the Divine Body of Fierce Sun bit by bit.

Within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the Divine Body of Fierce Sun is akin to the ‘favored child’ of heaven and earth, possessing great advantages in all aspects, be it cultivation, comprehension of principles, or even in the exertion of combat strength.

“I still have to continue condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan had not given up on condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun, but currently, the difficulty of condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun has surged, even for Lin Yuan, it takes several days to condense one.

And the efficiency of one per several days is gradually declining. As the number of condensed Seeds of the Fierce Sun continues to rise, it becomes one in ten days, then one in several dozen days.

“Now the situation…”

Lin Yuan ended his cultivation and glanced outside.

Since Lin Yuan’s intervention led to the failure of the Purple Dream Domain’s plans.

The Qingfen Domain has been in a standoff with the Purple Dream Domain, with no sign of retreat from the other side, and they have even marshaled troops for gather at the border.

The armies of this ancient country in the Source World all appeared in the form of battle formations. A battle formation composed of one hundred thousand of the eleventh layer can concentrate all the strength of one hundred thousand eleventh-layer members, enhance it, and the resulting strike is enough to severely wound a Path Splitting Realm expert.

Whoosh.

Just then.

Lord Qingfen appeared.

“The actions on the Purple Dream Domain are directed by the ‘Spirit Might King’, the war is likely inevitable.”

“Short as a few hundred years, long as several thousand years.”

Lord Qingfen straightforwardly remarked.

Recently, not only is the situation on the Purple Dream Domain delicate, but dozens of large domains near the Purple Dream Domain are also surging with undercurrents.

“The Spirit Might King?”

Lin Yuan nodded; he has also heard of this newly crowned king, rare for being bestowed king status with royal identity, most crowned kings being Heavenly Venerate-level experts.

“But it’s just war; our Fierce Sun Ancient Country is not afraid.”

Lord Qingfen looked at Lin Yuan and reminded: “Just make sure you don’t leave Qingfen City recently; I worry the ‘Spirit Might King’ might target you.”

If it weren’t for Lin Yuan, the Spirit Might King would find taking Qingfen City and even the Qingfen Domain far easier.

Thus, Lord Qingfen had this concern.

“Rest assured, I certainly won’t leave.”

Lin Yuan immediately replied, having sold off the Heart of Myriad Formation, Lin Yuan wouldn’t lack resources for a long time.

Not lacking resources, not lacking inheritance, even if it were to put Lin Yuan outside, he wouldn’t go.

“That is quite good.”

Lord Qingfen nodded before disappearing.

If the war really starts, being in the center of the Qingfen Domain will inevitably face the greatest pressure, and Lord Qingfen has been exceptionally busy lately.

Watching Lord Qingfen disappear.

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and continued to start cultivating again.

Whether it’s war or peace.

Anyway, cultivating and getting stronger is undeniably correct.

Time flowed.

In the blink of an eye, a thousand years passed.
